target_hardware.notes: Standard ESP32 devkit configuration matching Wokwi diagram

inputs.name: temperature_reading
inputs.description: Temperature measurement reading in Celsius passed to process_temperature()

outputs.name: FAN_PIN
outputs.description: Controls fan relay power stage (HIGH=ON, LOW=OFF)

sensors.name: Industrial Temperature Sensor
sensors.description: Measures ambient and equipment temperature across -20.0 C to 120.0 C range

actuators.name: Cooling Fan Relay
actuators.description: Relay driver circuit switching power to industrial cooling fan

peripherals.name: GPIO
peripherals.description: General Purpose IO driving fan relay and status LED

peripherals.name: UART0
peripherals.description: Serial communication for telemetry, diagnostics, and test logging via printf

communication_interfaces.protocol_details: Formatted ASCII serial logging via printf
communication_interfaces.description: Standard output for system boot, state transitions, and alert messages

important_conditions.description: Engage cooling fan when temperature exceeds threshold
Deactivate cooling fan when temperature is within normal limits
Immediate fault deactivation if sensor reading is out of physical bounds

boundary_conditions.behavior_at_or_below: Fan remains OFF; state is SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING
boundary_conditions.behavior_above: Fan turns ON; state is SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE
boundary_conditions.edge_case_notes: Boundary at 30.0 C: <= 30.0 C is OFF, strictly > 30.0 C turns fan ON. Values < -20.0 C or > 120.0 C trigger SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT

boundary_conditions.behavior_at_or_below: Values strictly below -20.0 C trigger SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT and turn fan OFF
boundary_conditions.edge_case_notes: Exactly -20.0 C is considered valid minimum normal reading

boundary_conditions.behavior_above: Values strictly above 120.0 C trigger SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT and turn fan OFF
boundary_conditions.edge_case_notes: Exactly 120.0 C is considered valid maximum normal reading

error_handling.recovery: Requires valid temperature reading within [-20.0, 120.0] or manual system reset

states.name: SYSTEM_INIT
states.description: Initial system boot and hardware configuration state

states.name: SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING
states.description: Operating normally with temperature <= 30.0 C; cooling fan is inactive

states.name: SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE
states.description: Temperature > 30.0 C; cooling fan relay is actively energized

states.name: SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT
states.description: Sensor fault or disconnection detected; cooling fan forced to safe state (OFF)

state_transitions.description: Transition from boot state to normal cooling idle
Fan activates when temperature exceeds 30.0 C

state_transitions.trigger: Temperature cools down to threshold or below
state_transitions.description: Fan deactivates when temperature returns to normal range
Fault detected while fan is running

requirements.name: temperature_processing_latency
requirements.description: Fan relay must update state within 10 ms of receiving new temperature reading

requirements.name: sensor_sample_rate
requirements.description: Periodic temperature sampling interval in production loop

timing_behavior.description: Synchronous control loop processing sequential temperature events and immediate GPIO actuation

assumptions.statement: GPIO pin 13 is wired to an active-HIGH relay driver circuit controlling the cooling fan.
assumptions.impact_if_violated: Fan would turn ON when disabled and turn OFF when enabled if active-LOW relay is used.

assumptions.statement: Temperature sensor driver supplies floating-point Celsius values to process_temperature().
assumptions.impact_if_violated: Fixed-point or raw ADC values would produce incorrect threshold comparison.

assumptions.statement: Physical temperature sensor disconnection causes an out-of-range value such as -99.0 C or open-circuit reading.
assumptions.impact_if_violated: Disconnection may not be detected if ADC floats to a valid in-range reading.

testable_behaviors.name: System Boot Announcement
testable_behaviors.description: Verify system initializes and emits boot log and configuration on startup

testable_behaviors.name: Normal Temperature Inactive Fan
testable_behaviors.description: When temperature is 25.0 C (below 30.0 C threshold), fan remains OFF
testable_behaviors.verification_criteria: Fan GPIO pin is LOW and log reports Normal Range

testable_behaviors.name: High Temperature Fan Activation
testable_behaviors.description: When temperature reaches 32.5 C (> 30.0 C), fan turns ON
testable_behaviors.verification_criteria: Fan GPIO pin is set to HIGH (ON) and log reports Threshold Exceeded

testable_behaviors.name: Temperature Cooldown Fan Deactivation
testable_behaviors.description: When temperature drops from 32.5 C to 28.0 C (<= 30.0 C), fan turns OFF
testable_behaviors.verification_criteria: Fan GPIO pin switches back to LOW and state returns to normal

testable_behaviors.name: Sensor Disconnect Fault Handling
testable_behaviors.description: When sensor is disconnected (reading -99.0 C, < -20.0 C), fan forces OFF and transitions to fault state
testable_behaviors.expected_serial_log: ERROR: SENSOR_DISCONNECTED or invalid reading (-99.0 C)!
testable_behaviors.verification_criteria: System reports SENSOR_DISCONNECTED, fan is forced OFF, and state transitions to SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT

testable_behaviors.name: Upper Bound Extreme Fault Handling
testable_behaviors.description: When temperature exceeds maximum sensor range (> 120.0 C, e.g. 135.0 C), system enters fault state
testable_behaviors.verification_criteria: System flags fault state and deactivates fan relay

testable_behaviors.name: Exact Boundary 30.0 C Inactive Fan
testable_behaviors.description: When temperature is exactly 30.0 C, fan should remain OFF as condition is strictly > 30.0 C
